summary: 本地优先 MCP 监督器：从历史 agent 会话挖掘有效工作流，跨代改进并仅推广经过再验证的胜利。
description: Loop Factory MCP — a local-first supervisor for evidence-gated AI agent loops. Mines past agent sessions for workflows that worked, improves them generation over generation, and only promotes a measured, re-verified win. Zero dependencies, MCP over stdio.
